item.title: White House accuses China of collecting US voter data
item.description: The Trump administration on Thursday repeated its claim that China attempted to gather millions of American voter registration files.

item.title: Renovation reveals wallet lost decades ago with treasured family photos
item.description: More than 50 years after librarian Kathleen Regan lost her wallet at a Massachusetts high school, workers discovered it during renovations.

item.title: Kyiv says Russian missile entered Polish airspace amid deadly strikes
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy attributed multiple deaths across Ukraine to insufficient or delayed air defense supplies.

item.title: New documentary honors escaped NYC owl Flaco
item.description: ABC News' Danny New reports on a documentary about the Eurasian Eagle owl that gained fame after escaping the Central Park Zoo.
